heading: Exemption of minimum quantities
lead: The Secretary may, by regulation, exempt from compliance with the provisions of this chapter (1) any variety or varieties of grapes and plums, and (2) the shipment of such minimum quantities of grapes and plums to any foreign country as he may prescribe.

notes.text: Amendments1961—Pub. L. 87–105 added cl. (1) and designated existing provisions as cl. (2).
